text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
recommended the re-examination of the present Trade
Agreement between the Republic of the Philippines and
the United States of America in the light of the new
conditions;
WHEREAS, a number of committees were previously in-
formally created to undertake preliminary studies of the
various aspects of the two agreements and the problems
involved therein;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby create a Committee to
(a) evaluate, study and coordinate the reports submitted by
the committees and groups heretofore created, and pur-
sue such further study as may be demed necessary; and
(½) consider the advisability of, and make a recommendation
on, the revision of the Trade Agreement between the
Philippines and the United States.
The Committee shall be composed of:
: 1: The Honorable Aurelio Montinola
2. The Honorable Joaquin M. Elizalde
3. The Honorable Lorenzo Sumülong ....
1. The Honorable Vicente Madrigal .....
5. The Honorable Francisco Delgadc
6. The Honorable Diosdado Macapagal
7. The Honorable Daniel Romualdez
8. The Honorable Estanislao Fernandez
9. The Honorable Cornelio Balmaceda ..
10. The Honorable Miguel Cuaderno
11. The Honorable: Salvador Aranets
12. The Honorable Conrado Benitez
13. Prof. Vicente G. Sinco
14. The Honorable Antonio de las Alas
15. Mr. Jose P. Marcelo
§
The Committee may call upon any department, bureau,
office, or any agency or instrumentality of the Philippine
Government for such assistance as it may need in the
performance of its functions. It shall submit its report
to the President as early as possible.
All orders, circulars or instructions inconsistent here-
with are hereby repealed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of April, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1257
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
